name: -8AN ORB to 3/8" Quick Connect
title: -8AN ORB to 3/8" Quick Connect
description:
The -8AN ORB to 3/8" Quick Connect is engineered for demanding high-performance automotive fluid systems. the ORB quick connect is now available in Black

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: Premium high-grade construction with corrosion-resistant coating.
• Sealing Type: Viton O-Ring Boss (ORB) positive seal to prevent thread sealant contamination.
• Quick Connect: High-pressure fuel rail latch mechanism.
